title: Hacker News Scraper Input
description: Collect feed items, search Hacker News, or fetch specific item IDs. No login, API key, or proxy is required.

mode.title: Collection mode
mode.description: Choose a Hacker News feed, keyword search, or explicit item IDs.

feed.title: Feed
feed.description: The official Hacker News feed to collect when mode is Feed.

query.title: Search query
query.description: Full-text query used in Keyword search mode.

searchType.title: Search result type
searchType.description: Search stories or comments through the public HN Algolia API.

itemIds.title: Item IDs
itemIds.description: Numeric Hacker News item IDs used in Specific item IDs mode.

maxResults.title: Maximum results
maxResults.description: Maximum number of records written to the dataset. Start small for testing, especially when nested comments are enabled.

minScore.title: Minimum score
minScore.description: Keep items with at least this many points.

minComments.title: Minimum comment count
minComments.description: Keep stories with at least this many comments.

includeKeywords.title: Include keywords
includeKeywords.description: Keep records containing at least one keyword in the title or text. Leave empty to disable.

excludeKeywords.title: Exclude keywords
excludeKeywords.description: Remove records containing any of these keywords in the title or text.

authors.title: Authors
authors.description: Only keep records by these exact Hacker News usernames.

domain.title: Domain contains
domain.description: Only keep external links whose hostname contains this value.

fromDate.title: Published after
fromDate.description: Optional ISO date or date-time, for example 2026-01-01.

toDate.title: Published before
toDate.description: Optional ISO date or date-time, for example 2026-12-31.

includeComments.title: Include nested comments
includeComments.description: Fetch comments and nest them inside each result record.

maxCommentsPerItem.title: Maximum comments per item
maxCommentsPerItem.description: Maximum nested comments fetched for each result. A run may request at most 5,000 comments across all results.

commentDepth.title: Comment depth
commentDepth.description: Maximum nested reply depth to traverse.

includeDeadOrDeleted.title: Include dead or deleted items
includeDeadOrDeleted.description: Include records marked dead or deleted by Hacker News.
